### When We’re Stuck In a Mess
Author: Lysa TerKeurst
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-august-20-2020.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 2:2-3
Points:
- Difficult circumstances and personal failures can make believers feel trapped in aimless wandering.
- God intervened in Israel's circling pattern by directing them to turn toward a new destination.
- Hard seasons provide an opportunity to decide whether trials will define us or refine us.
- Moving forward requires replacing defeating thoughts with the truth of God's Word.
- God extends grace rather than condemnation when calling His people to advance into His promises.

### Fruitful Desert
Author: Jennifer Kennedy Dean
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-june-24-2016.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 2:7
Points:
- Barren and exhausting seasons are often the places where God produces the deepest spiritual fruit.
- God's active guidance and provision are often most clearly recognized in hindsight.
- In the wilderness, believers come to the end of self-sufficiency and learn to cling to the Lord.
- Hardship highlights God's love and attentiveness in stark contrast to surrounding difficulties.
- The spiritual lessons learned during dry times prepare believers for the next stretch of their journey.

### With Us in the Wilderness
Author: Jennifer Waddle
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/with-us-in-the-wilderness-bible-study-minute-january-18-2018.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 2:7
Points:
- Times of hardship and testing are painful, particularly because their duration remains unknown.
- God does not merely observe our struggles from afar; He journeys through the wilderness with us.
- God uses trials like a refiner's fire to surface and remove impurities in our hearts.
- Surrendering our motives and actions to God allows His refining work to prepare us for future blessings.

### The Final Step of the Journey
Author: Kristina Seymour
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/warrior-mom-wisdom/the-final-step-of-the-journey-warrior-mom-wisdom-week-of-october-6.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 2:7
Points:
- The final stages of a lengthy season of trial are often accompanied by severe physical fatigue.
- Believers can feel completely worn out physically while remaining spiritually victorious in Christ.
- The boundary between weary endurance and the fulfillment of God's promise is often just one step away.
- Remembering God's faithful past care through vast deserts supplies the strength to keep marching.
